verdict.rationale: OpenTofu documents a `tofu import` command that finds an existing resource by ID and brings it into state at a given address. A community comment also notes for_each support on import blocks. Nothing in the evidence shows OpenTofu generating matching configuration code for imported resources, so only the import half of the story is evidenced. Missing for 10: documented config-code generation for imported resources, depth of docs on import-block workflows, hands-on corroboration of import at scale.
